description: Mark some notifications (ids) or all of them read for the signed-in person. opened: true when the person tapped through, which also records that they opened it. Answers the unread count left.

before.description: With all: only notifications created at or before this time (the newest one shown), so rows that arrived since stay unread

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

ids.description: The notifications to mark read; leave out with all

opened.description: true when the person tapped through: also sets opened_at and records notification_opened

name: notifications_mark_read
title: Mark notifications read
